<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
I found an insect I've never seen,
so I came to report it!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CV 3,2>Eliza!
Good of you to come. Show me.

This is... a kind of parasite...
But why, without parasitising...

Gathered in a swarm?
Then that place is its dwelling...

This parasite seems to control its host
and return to its own dwelling.

A Parasite Bug, one might say.
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>We did it, Hunter!
A great discovery!
